A unique quirky abstract Procreate digital brush created from a illustration I digitally hand drew. Inspired by an Art Deco, art nouveau, dark academia, Steampunk mood. WHAT’S INCLUDED :
-1 Procreate digital brush
MORE INFO ON THE BRUSH:
Brush #1 – An individual Procreate brush from the ‘Abstract Suite Collection’ series of Procreate Brushes in this shop (ZaraRozaDesigns)
-This brush has pressure sensitive size. Pressing harder and the width of the line will get bigger, press lighter and the line width will get narrower. 
IMPORTING THE BRUSH TO PROCREATE:
-Go to downloads on your ipad or the location you downloaded the .brush file to.
-Press on the .brush file, then it should import to Procreate (the iPad should automatically take you to Procreate, say ‘importing’ with a blue tick under it).
-Click on any artwork or create a new artwork. Then go to the brush icon in Procreate (on the upper right) and the ‘Brush Library’ dropdown menu should appear. Scroll up through the list of brush sets on the left to the top where the brush set should be. 
Thank you so much for stopping by the shop. Happy drawing! 🙂
Zara Roza Designs
